description: Validate an LLM function call / tool_use output: check that function name is in allowed list, arguments match expected schema (types, enums, ranges), no extra/missing args. Reads the definitions as OpenAI (`parameters`), MCP (`inputSchema`) or Anthropic (`input_schema`) write them, or as plain `required_args`/`optional_args`; reads the call as `arguments` (object or JSON string), `input` (Anthropic tool_use) or an OpenAI `{function:{…}}` wrapper.

allowed_functions.description: List of allowed function definitions, in OpenAI, MCP or Anthropic form, or as {name, required_args, optional_args}

parameters.description: OpenAI form: a JSON Schema of the arguments

function_call.description: The function call object from LLM (e.g. { "name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city":"Paris"} })

name: function_call_validate
